interpretation: The response-blind census spans 78 qualified state records from five immutable artifact sources and 65 unique H/theta states after bit-level deduplication.
Fifty-nine pairs satisfy both the total-profile-water and upper-30-cm-water controls, so the NO_MATCH is not caused by absence of storage-matched comparisons.
None of those 59 pairs reaches the preregistered 0.01 cm deep-centroid separation.
The strongest storage-matched deep-centroid separation is 0.0004048112988499497 cm, only about 4.05% of the frozen gate.

Within the currently qualified C01 state library, matching total water and upper-30-cm water also constrains the remaining 30-160 cm distribution much more tightly than required for an E04 response falsification.
This is a state-space availability result, not proof that total water plus root30 water is globally sufficient.
nonclaims: No global state-sufficiency conclusion is admitted.
No production coupling or second MODFLOW state change follows.
No response quantity influenced pair construction or ranking.

next_step_basis.rationale: Further reuse of the same immutable state library cannot produce a qualifying pair under unchanged gates. A new experiment must add an independently controlled deep-state construction axis rather than retune selection thresholds.
